zh: When did the word of the LORD first come to Zechariah? To whom should Israel return? Who will return to them? What should they turn away from? How many years had the LORD been angry with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah? Which nations was He especially angry with, and why? To which place will the LORD return to show mercy? What will be rebuilt? On what will the measuring line be stretched? Which towns will again overflow with prosperity? Where will the LORD again bring comfort? Which city will He choose? What are the four horns? What do the four craftsmen do? Who will be a wall of fire around Jerusalem and the glory within her? What must Joshua the high priest do in order to govern the house and have charge of the courts of the LORD? What must not be relied upon, but what must be relied upon for success? What are the seven eyes, and what do the two olive trees on either side of the golden lampstand represent? 撒加利亞書 5—8 飛行的書卷進入誰家？ 量器被抬到哪裡去？ 什麼是天的四風？ 誰要在本處長起來，建造耶和華的殿，擔負尊榮，坐在位上掌王權，又要作祭司，使兩職之間籌定和平？ 以色列人在五月、七月禁食悲哀已經多少年了？ 四月、五月禁食的日子，以及七月、十月禁食的日子，將來必變為什麼樣的日子與節期？ 是誰使美好之地荒涼了？ 誰將回到錫安、住在耶路撒冷？耶路撒冷必稱為誠實的城，萬軍之耶和華的山必稱為聖山，為什麼？

Into whose house does the flying scroll enter? Where is the basket taken? What are the four winds of heaven? Who will branch out from his place, build the temple of the LORD, be clothed with majesty, sit and rule on his throne, and serve as priest, bringing harmony between the two? For how many years have Israel fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months? What will the fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months become in the future? Who made the pleasant land desolate? Who will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem? Why will Jerusalem be called the Faithful City and the mountain of the LORD of hosts called the Holy Mountain? 撒加利亞書 9—12 新約哪卷書引用撒加利亞書 9：9（「錫安的民哪，應當大大喜樂…」）？ 兩根杖各稱為什麼？折斷它們象徵什麼？ 撒加利亞書 11：12—13 在新約哪裡應驗？ 聖經哪卷書引用「他們必仰望我，就是他們所扎的」？

Which New Testament books quote Zechariah 9:9 (“Rejoice greatly, Daughter Zion…”)? What are the two staffs called? What does breaking them represent? Where in the New Testament is Zechariah 11:12–13 fulfilled? Which New Testament book quotes, “They will look on me, the one they have pierced”? 撒加利亞書 13—14 新約哪卷書引用「擊打牧人，羊就分散」？ 那日，誰的腳必站在耶路撒冷前面朝東的橄欖山上？這山將有什麼變化？ 誰必降臨，並有一切聖者同來？ 誰必作全地的王？那日誰的名必是獨一無二的？ 誰必年年上來敬拜大君王萬軍之耶和華，並守住棚節？
